Trim Video Online

Keep just the part of the video you need. Free, no sign-up, your file stays on your device.

  • Free, no sign-up
  • Processed on your device
  • No watermark

About this tool

Write the start and end times and Ubahin saves that part as a new video. How it works: the section is played in the browser and recorded again, so processing takes as long as the clip (a 30-second clip takes about 30 seconds). Keep the tab open. Because it is re-recorded, quality can differ slightly from the original, and the result is MP4 or WEBM depending on the browser.

How to use it

  1. Choose a file

    Drag a file into the box above or click to pick one from your device.

  2. Adjust the options

    Choose the format or quality, then press the process button.

  3. Download the result

    Save the files one by one or all at once in a ZIP.

Frequently asked questions

Why does it take as long as the video?
Re-recording in the browser runs at playback speed. Cutting a shorter part is quicker.
Does quality drop?
Slightly, because the video is re-encoded. For trimming with no quality loss, use a video editing app on your device.
Is there no sound?
On some browsers audio cannot be recorded. If that happens, the result is marked with a note.
Is my file uploaded to a server?
No. The conversion runs in your browser, so the file stays on your device. Only program components (such as the PDF library) are downloaded from this site; for HEIC and MP3 one extra component is also loaded from jsDelivr. Your file is not sent along.
What is the file size limit?
Ubahin allows 200 MB per file, but the real limit depends on your device memory. Very large files can make the browser slow or stop.
Is it free? Do I need to sign up?
Free, with no account. There is no watermark on the results.
